title: I Followed the Pharmacy Drive-Thru Camera After They Denied the Wait

parts.text: The app said ready. I sat in drive-thru for twenty-six minutes while cars with later tickets pulled around because someone inside kept waving friends. I was thirty-six, sick, holding a ticket 14. They said they had no record of a wait. The camera over the canopy had a time overlay. I asked for the manager and the overlay. Ticket 14 went first after that. I swallowed the pill in a Target parking lot. Friends can use the lot. The canopy is a queue. Apps that say ready should mean ready, not social hour. I still use that pharmacy because the camera, once invited, stays invited.
